articles.summary: Algonquin Power Utilities Corp. (“AQN”) (TSX: AQN, AQN.PR.A, AQN.PR.D, NYSE: AQN) announced today that its board of directors has approved and declared the following common and preferred share dividends: US$0.0650 per common share, payable on October 15, 2026, to the shareholders of record on September 29, 2026, for the period from July 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026. Registered shareholders can elect to receive the dividend in Canadian dollars in the amount of C$0.0912. C$0.41100 per preferred share, Series A, payable in cash on October 1, 2026 to preferred share, Series A holders of record on September 15, 2026, for the period from June 30, 2026 to, but excluding, September 30, 2026. C$0.42831 per preferred share, Series D, payable in cash on October 1, 2026 to preferred share, Series D holders of record on September 15, 2026, for the period from June 30, 2026 to, but excluding, September 30, 2026.
